newsitem.title: USA: U.S. seeks deportation of accused Nazi officer.
newsitem.headline: U.S. seeks deportation of accused Nazi officer.

text.p: The U.S. Justice Department said on Tuesday that it began deportation proceedings against an accused officer and platoon commander in a Nazi-sponsored Lithuanian unit during the Second World War.

It filed the notice in U.S. immigration court in Philadelphia against Jonas Stelmokas, 80, a retired architect who allegedly served in a Nazi-sponsored Lithuanian unit from 1941 to 1944, when he was transferred to the German Air Force.

A federal judge in Philadelphia in 1995 stripped Stelmokas of his U.S. citizenship, ruling that he had misrepresented his wartime activities when he entered the United States. A U.S. appeals court upheld the decision last year.
In the deportation case, the Justice Department alleged that Stelmokas was ineligible to immigrate to the United States because he had concealed his service in the Nazi unit when applying for a visa.
Department officials said he falsely claimed he had been a teacher and then unemployed from 1940 until 1944. The notice does not specify the country the United States seeks to deport him to.
